macros.name: amxgenerate
macros.doc: Generates the full table incorporating the previously registered data.

macros.name: amxReset
macros.doc: Clears all internal data structures and customisations for the package, allowing the user to later typeset a different, independent matrix.

macros.name: amxrow
macros.doc: Registers the row entry named <key> with the given <text>.

macros.name: amxsetColumnHeading
macros.doc: Sets the rendered table’s top row’s cells to be rendered via passing the column heading’s text (see Section 2.2) to the given <render-command>.

macros.name: amxsetIndicator
macros.doc: Sets the indicators of association in the matrix in non-highlighting mode to the result of the <indicator>.

macros.name: amxsetIndicatorHighlighted
macros.doc: Sets the indicators of association in the matrix in highlighting mode to the result of the <hl-indicator> for the highlighted row and <ot-indicator> for every other row.
